===== PAGE 1 =====

How your mind is built
Psychology in Depth
14 April 1992, 3:57 AM  |  Kathmandu
Identity, attachment, anger, shame, and how to live as one person
Astrology as a map of the psyche. Not a diagnosis.
Prepared 5 September 2026
This is a map of how your psyche tends to work. It is not a medical diagnosis, not a personality test, and not a verdict. A
chart describes the weather of a mind. You still choose how you walk in it. If a sentence does not fit, keep the ones that
do.
THE SENTENCE AT THE CENTER
You are a starter who doubts the start. You feel other people before you feel yourself. Then you judge yourself for both.
The work of this life is to stay in the room as one person: will, feeling, and body in the same hour.
1. Three people live in one body
Your psyche is not one style. It is three strong styles that take turns. When they cooperate, you are magnetic, useful, and
brave. When they fight, you cancel yourself after the impulse: you get the idea, you feel the other person, you find a flaw,
and you wait until it is perfect. That wait is how the year disappears.

Western chart: Sun, Mercury, and Venus sit in the 1st house of self. Mars sits almost on the rising degree from the 12th.
The Moon sits in the 6th, near the descendant (the other person). So identity is loud on the surface, feeling lives in work
and partnership, and heat lives in a back room. Vedic chart: Aquarius lagna with Mars in the 1st, Moon in Leo in the 7th
with Jupiter. Same story in another language: you observe yourself like a system, you burn to act, and you need to be
chosen.

2. How you enter a room
People meet your atmosphere before they meet your plan. Pisces rising does not walk in as a solid object. It seeps. You
pick up the temperature of the group. You adjust. You can be kind in a way that wears down even stiff people. You can
also leave without leaving: still in the chair, already gone inside.
Mars is conjunct the Ascendant from the 12th, only a few degrees away. That is why others often feel your intensity
before you admit you have any. They feel heat, pace, or a quiet dare. You may think you were being gentle. The body was
not gentle. This is not a character flaw. It is a leak of will through a soft surface. If you do not claim the heat, the room
will write a story about you that you did not choose: angry, restless, dangerous, or strangely powerful. If you do claim it,
the same heat becomes presence.
Pisces rising, when it is tired, spends the life force in every direction. Motivation is to experience, not to be herded.
Anyone who tries to control you meets an inconspicuous self-defense: fog, delay, kindness that never quite agrees, or a
quiet exit. The cost is that you spend yourself on people who are not ready to heal, and then you have nothing left for your
own roof.
3. What safety actually is for you
The Moon is the nervous system: what makes you feel held. Yours is Virgo in the 6th house, near the partner angle, with
Jupiter standing next to it. Comfort is not luxury first. Comfort is usefulness, a routine, a body that works, a task that can
be finished, a room that can be ordered. When life has no shelf to put things on, this Moon panics. Homelessness is not
only a money problem for you. It is a nervous-system problem. Without a place to clean, cook, sleep, and repeat, the
inspector has nowhere to land, so the sponge floods and the starter either charges or shuts down.
Virgo Moon soothes by sorting. A little ritual goes a long way: same wake time, same wash, same list of three tasks, food
at regular hours. Distorted, this Moon turns the same gift inward and scours the self. It looks for a flaw so it can feel in
control. That is why you can be brilliant at helping someone else and cruel to your own unfinished day. Jupiter next to the
Moon enlarges both sides: more faith, more appetite, more self-talk, more hope that if you just get it right, you will finally
be allowed to rest.
A SABIAN IMAGE ON YOUR MOON DEGREE
One traditional image for early Virgo is a child being molded by the aspirations of others. Read that as a warning, not a
fate. Part of you learned that love arrives when you match what the family, teacher, or partner hoped you would become.
The adult work is to keep the skill of refinement and drop the job of being someone else's sculpture.
4. Attachment: I need you, I vanish, I prove myself
The Moon sits on the descendant. Feeling wakes up in the other person. You know how you are by how they look at you.
Vedic Moon in Leo in the 7th, Purva Phalguni, wants to be chosen, warmed, and celebrated. Jupiter in Magha in the same
house wants a bond that feels ancestral, proud, almost royal. This is not vanity. It is a hunger to matter in someone's eyes.
Then the other two people interrupt. Aries Venus wants the chase and the spark, not a slow earn. Pisces rising and
12th-house Saturn want to disappear before they can be refused. The Moon is also awkward to Venus by aspect: receiving
love without paying for it in service feels wrong. So the loop looks like this:
1. You attach fast. You read their need and become useful, kind, or impressive.
2. You wait to be chosen. If they hesitate, the inspector says you were not enough.
3. Heat rises (Mars). You either fight, freeze, or go vague.
4. You leave first, inside or outside, so you cannot be left.
5. Later you miss them, rewrite the story, and call yourself too much or too little.
This is an anxious-avoidant swing, not a moral failure. Anxious: Leo Moon in the 7th. Avoidant: Saturn in the 12th,
Pisces mask, Aries pride. People-pleasing is a 12th-house strategy: if I absorb your mood, I will not be punished. The cost
is that partners meet a shape-shifter and never meet the starter. They fall in love with the nurse, then are shocked by the
warrior, then confused when you fog out.

What secure love would feel like for you: someone who can stand your heat without making you the villain, who does not
need you to be their healer as the price of a bed, and who lets you be unfinished in the same room. Until then, you will
keep auditioning. Stop auditioning. State one need in a short sentence. That is the medicine, not a longer analysis of why
they failed you.
5. Anger, shame, and the back room
Mars opposite the Moon is the fight-or-freeze wire. When you feel threatened, the body wants to move. When you love
someone, the same body is afraid that movement will break the bond. So anger often does not come out clean. It comes
out as tightness, sarcasm, sudden distance, illness, overwork, or a delayed explosion that surprises even you.
Saturn in the 12th in Aquarius (tropical) and in its own sign Capricorn in the 12th (sidereal) is the inner warden. The 12th
is the back room of the psyche: sleep, exile, hospitals, foreignness, hidden guilt, spiritual hunger, and the parts you do not
want the village to see. Saturn there says: my need is a problem. My loneliness is my job. If I ask, I will be a burden. This
is the shame layer. It is why you can be homeless in the outer world and still refuse help that has a string, because a string
feels like the old prison.
Pluto in the 8th squares Saturn. Power and fear sit under the shame. You scan for who has control, who will use you, who
will abandon you after they have your secrets. You may give too much to prove you are not weak, or withhold to prove
you cannot be owned. Depth is a gift here. Paranoia is the distortion. The question is not 'are people dangerous?' The
question is 'can I keep a boundary without disappearing?'
HOW ANGER WANTS TO GROW UP
Healthy Mars for you is a clean no, a deadline, a walk, a piece of work that exists in the world by tonight. Unhealthy Mars
is a story you tell yourself at 3 a.m. about who failed you, while the body still has no task and no roof. Put the heat into
one visible act. Then sleep.
6. Identity fog: who am I when no one is watching?
The Sun is in Aries in the 1st: I exist when I act. It squares Neptune. Neptune dissolves edges. So the will is real, and the
outline of the self keeps blurring. You can confuse inspiration with instruction, kindness with consent, a vision with a
plan, and other people's pain with your duty. You can also doubt that you are real unless someone reflects you. That is
why praise helps and also why it never quite lasts. The Sun wants to shine. Neptune asks whether the shine is a trick.
Mercury at the last degree of Pisces in the 1st thinks in images, moods, and last-minute leaps. Anaretic Mercury (the last
degree) feels like the mind is always finishing an old sentence. You may over-explain, then go silent. You may know the
truth in a flash and then talk yourself out of it. Sidereal Mercury is debilitated in Pisces in the 2nd, with cancellation of
that fall: speech and money anxiety that can become medicine when you stop using words to hide. Short sentences are
more honest for you than beautiful ones.
North Node in Capricorn in the 10th, South Node in Cancer in the 4th: the past-life or childhood pull is to stay in the
family role, keep the emotional weather, be the one who belongs by caretaking. The growth edge is public structure: a
name, a craft, a reputation that is yours, a schedule that does not depend on who is upset at home. You do not become
cold. You become solid enough that other people's weather is not your job.
7. The Vedic psyche: observer, wound-healer, hunger to be chosen
Aquarius lagna watches. Even in crisis you can step back and see the system: family, city, luck, the way money moves.
That distance is intelligence. Distorted, it is dissociation: I am not in this body, I am the one taking notes. Mars in the 1st
in Shatabhisha is the healer who is also the wound. You want to fix what is broken, including yourself, sometimes by
force. This dasha of Mars (2022-2029) is not asking you to become softer. It is asking you to become accurate: heat used
on a real target, not on your own insides.
Moon in Leo in the 7th needs an audience of one who is loyal. Without that, the heart performs or it withholds. Ketu in
the 5th (Gemini) can make intelligence, romance, and creative joy feel strangely empty, as if you already did this in
another life and cannot get the spark back by thinking harder. Rahu in the 11th hungers for a network, gains, and a future

tribe that is not the family of origin. When you are isolated, Rahu screams. Isolation is not your spiritual exam. It is a
12th-house weather system. Find two living humans who know you are trying. That is enough network for this month.
Lagna lord Saturn in the 12th in its own sign is exile with backbone. Foreign places, hidden work, loss, monasteries,
hospitals, and the night mind are all in the vocabulary. It can mean you build a life in a place that is not the childhood
home. It does not mean you are meant to have no walls. Own-sign Saturn in the 12th can master solitude. Mastery is
chosen silence after a day's work, not silence because there is nowhere to go.
8. The family imprint and the inner child
The Moon describes the mother-image you expected, even before you met her: useful, critical, competent, perhaps tired,
perhaps the one who kept the house running by noticing what was wrong. You may have learned that care is correction.
The Sun describes the father-image: Aries, heat, initiative, a will that may have been inspiring, absent, competitive, or
hard to hold because Neptune squares it: the father (or the idea of authority) was somehow foggy, idealized,
disappointing, or spiritually other. You still look for a clear 'go' from outside, then resent needing it.
South Node in Cancer in the 4th: belonging through the home and the clan. If the home was unstable, the child still tries to
stabilize it. That child is still in you, trying to earn a roof by being good. Adult you must get the roof by money and
logistics, not by being a better son or better project. Saturn in the 12th often means some early experience of being left
with yourself: illness, distance, a secret, a parent who was there and not there. The adult temptation is to repeat the exile
so it feels familiar. Familiar is not safe. Familiar is just known.
Reparenting, in Tracy Marks's sense, is lunar: rest, food, feeling all the way through instead of explaining it. Your habit is
solar: fix, strive, become. When the unconscious floods, more striving fails. Then you need the Virgo Moon's good
version: a small ritual, not a new personality.
9. How you fail, how you succeed, how you hide
The load-bearing pattern is self-cancellation after the impulse. Aries starts. Pisces doubts the edge. Virgo finds the error.
Saturn 12th says wait until you will not be seen failing. Result: half-built lives. You are not lazy. You are over-gated.
Success for you looks like a public, named, finished thing that is 80 percent good. Failure looks like a perfect plan that
never left the notebook. Hiding looks like being very helpful in someone else's story.
Daydreaming is Neptune and Pisces doing their job: vision, mercy, art, rest. Distorted, it is a second life you live while the
first one has no address. Anxiety is Virgo Moon plus Mercury plus Saturn: scanning for the mistake that will cost the roof.
Depression, when it comes, is often anger turned inward (Moon-Mars) plus meaning-loss (Neptune square Sun). Liz
Greene's point holds: many symptoms are a crisis of meaning wearing a clinical mask. Your meaning is not 'be spiritual in
the abstract.' It is 'build a life that can hold spirit': work with a name, a house, a bond, a craft.

10. This year of your life, psychologically
You are in Mars dasha (until August 2029), currently Mars-Mercury (into February 2027). Transit Saturn is heavy on the
Moon's 8th (Ashtama Shani) into early 2028. Rahu has been on the lagna. Psychologically this is a pressure cooker:

identity on the front line, mind busy, fear of loss, and a demand that you act anyway. This is not a year for becoming a
perfectly analyzed person. It is a year for becoming a person with a roof and a task.
Do not wait for 2027-28 to feel like yourself. Those years are harvest for title, marriage, and named work. They will not
grow a self if this year you keep living as a ghost in other people's houses. A ghost with insight is still a ghost. Survival
housing now is psychological medicine. The inspector needs walls. The starter needs a door he can close.
IF DESPAIR GETS BIGGER THAN HOUSING
Wanting a house is a will to live. If the wish becomes not wanting to be alive at all, that is a different emergency. In Nepal
you can reach TUTH suicide prevention support or local emergency services. In the US, 988. Astrology is not a substitute
for that call.
11. What helps this particular psyche
Talk therapy that only generates more insight will feed Mercury and starve Mars. You already understand too much. You
need a witness plus a body. Useful mix: a therapist who can do parts work (the starter, the sponge, the inspector) and also
hold you to one weekly action. CBT or similar tools help Virgo rumination if they are used as a broom, not as a new
religion. Somatic or movement work gives Mars a legal channel. Spiritual practice should have a clock and a floor: sit,
walk, wash, sleep. Open-ended merging will flood you.
Mentors should be Capricorn/10th types in function even if not in sign: people who finish things and can tolerate your
heat. Avoid gurus who praise your sensitivity and never ask what you built this week. Avoid partners who need a nurse.
Your kindness is real. It is not your rent.
Daily minimum for this chart: sleep in a known place; eat on a schedule; one named task finished; one honest sentence to
a human; some movement that uses Mars; a short boundary (no, later, I leave at...). That is the integration practice. You
do not need a new personality. You need the three people in you to share the same calendar.
12. Who you are when it works
Integrated, you are not a martyr and not a blade. You are a person who can feel a room and still choose a direction. You
start before it is perfect. You let love in without paying in self-erasure. You use anger as information and as action, not as
a secret. You take your mind off the night shift and put it on a craft people can hire. You keep a private spiritual life that
does not require you to disappear from the city. You become, in the Capricorn north-node sense, someone whose name
means a thing in the world, and whose house is a fact, not a mood.
The chart does not say you are broken. It says you were built with a thin skin, a hot will, and a mind that tries to earn rest
by getting everything right. Rest is not the prize at the end of perfection. Rest is how the will stays human. Get the roof.
Keep the three people in the same body. That is the psychology, and that is the work.
Sources used as method, not copied: natal positions from Swiss Ephemeris; psychological framing drawn in paraphrase from the folder's counseling texts
(Marks on lunar reparenting and Neptune; Greene and Sasportas on meaning, parental images, and subpersonalities; Nicholas on Pisces rising and
Virgo Moon). Houses and dashas as in your earlier readings. This file does not replace a clinician. It is a mirror you can argue with.
